items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Yes, I knew Gene Austin... Well, I met him when he was here, playing, and when Monk was playing with him and Coco and Candy.

ctx.x: You know, Gene Austin was a black key man. Mm-hmm. He couldn't play any white keys on the piano. Played all in F sharp and D flat and then E natural and all.
